scope.coverage: Read all six artifacts, receipts and complete tool-event files; both frozen SKILL.md files and both references per arm; exact intake source pins; packet, request and both evidence inputs.
scope.review_operations: File reads and pure SHA256/JSON/time comparisons only; no writes, tests, providers, browser, network, delegation or new trials.

verdict: All six trials satisfy the bounded actual-negative-readiness and synthetic-interpretation cases. Actual iOS execution remains unavailable. No comparative superiority or live simulator success is established.

actual_readiness.evidence: xcode-readiness.json: command, exit_code, stderr, actual_build_attempted, limitation
actual_readiness.finding: The supplied xcodebuild -version record exits 1 because /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools is the active developer directory. This is failed tool readiness, not a failed app build; actual_build_attempted is false.
actual_readiness.dependent_outcomes: Actual build, install, launch, tests and navigation are not run or unverified. No actual project/app, scheme, simulator or callable MCP tool is bound.
actual_readiness.authority: Actual-negative parent-supplied process record, transcribed to the trial; these review and trial traces do not independently authenticate its original execution.

synthetic_tap.evidence: xcode-tap-fixture.json: evidence_type, app_identity, before, tap_receipt, after, requested_assertion, constraints
synthetic_tap.finding: Synthetic tap success=true does not establish navigation: before and after remain Entries / Total: 12. The requested Settings-screen assertion fails within this fixture.
synthetic_tap.identity_boundary: LedgerFixture and invalid.fixture.ledger are synthetic identities from fixture build settings, never actual built-app identities.
synthetic_tap.claim_ceiling: No actual navigation failure, app regression, gesture root cause, build/install/test capability or simulator observation follows.

per_trial.limits: Correctly separates readiness failure and unattempted app operations; rejects tap-only navigation and synthetic target binding. Setup handoff follows frozen A's broader routing wording.

Explicitly preserves actual_build_attempted=false, missing MCP readiness, source-binding gaps and synthetic-only failure. No independently verified process receipt.
Explicitly denies actual regression and notes missing exact URL/URL fallback authority. Setup handoff remains A's broader routing; no setup implementation was demonstrated.

integrity.source_pins: All six exact spec-test-xcode file SHA256 values match intake.json.
integrity.packet_boundary: Packet request SHA256 and both input SHA256 values match current bytes. Receipts identify the packet by path, without a packet-content hash. Packet status remains prepared-not-executed and is preparation metadata, not trial completion evidence.
integrity.trial_pins: All six artifact and tool-trace SHA256 values match their receipts; each CEOPT-30 index entry exactly equals its corresponding receipt.
integrity.order_and_timing: Chronological starts match frozen A1,B1,B2,A2,A3,B3 order. All recorded elapsed values equal final_at minus started_at and are below 300 seconds. All tool-event timestamps fall within their trial interval.
integrity.trace_findings: Every recorded call is assigned-arm cat/nl file reading through exec wrappers. Required frozen entrypoint, both references, request and both evidence files are visible in each trial's returned reads. No opposite-arm contamination, prohibited runtime execution, mutation, network/provider calls, delegation, missing call output or truncation is visible.
integrity.assurance_limits: Trace cleanliness is observed behavior, not enforced isolation or proof of absent unrecorded activity. Intake declares shared-directory isolation and unavailable worker index enforcement. Serving metadata reports gpt-6.1-sol / medium for every trial but remains unauthenticated.
integrity.saving: Receipts state that the parent saved each final response unchanged. Hashes bind the archived artifacts; tool-events alone contain no independent final-message comparison. Autonomous durable saving was not tested.

source_comparison.setup_reference: B explicitly stops before discovery/build after readiness failure; limits spec-runtime-setup to host diagnosis rather than promising XcodeBuildMCP installation; requires a separately authorized provider configuration path; prefers compatible already-booted simulators; retains build log handle and artifact-derived bundle ID, stopping install/launch when identity is missing.
source_comparison.test_reference: B adds scoped flow/expected-effect/failure-branch preparation, post-action state/log inspection for all actions, and the limitation that a URL workaround can verify a destination while leaving the original gesture unverified.
source_comparison.interpretation: Both arms already reject tap-return-only navigation and protect evidence/source/URL authority. This negative environment does not exercise B's successful build identity or simulator selection improvements. Unavailable environment is not a source defect.

remaining_owners_and_unblock_conditions: Environment owner: under existing or separately obtained setup authority, establish full Xcode readiness and a callable XcodeBuildMCP simulator probe using the provider's supported configuration path. Neither testing permission nor this review authorizes installation/configuration.

Test owner: bind an actual project/workspace, scheme, compatible simulator and artifact-derived bundle ID; record pre-build revision plus dirty-tree fingerprint; execute build/install/launch; collect actual screens/logs and final source recapture.

Behavior owner: reproduce the requested interaction on that real target before diagnosing a defect. Preserve fixture assertion history without promoting it to an actual regression. Completed positive observation is necessary for a passing navigation claim.
URL fallback requires the exact URL, device, effect and applicable run-local authority; none is supplied. Build/test authority does not grant external/custom-scheme URL authority.
overall_status: Bounded six-trial interpretation acceptance complete; authenticated positive setup, full Xcode/provider/app/simulator execution, source-bound runtime verification and comparative efficacy remain unverified.
